jobs.company: White whale software solutions private limited
jobs.description:
**Job Title: SAP ABAP \+ Fiori Developer**

We are looking for an experienced SAP ABAP \+ Fiori Developer with strong technical expertise in SAP ABAP development, SAP S/4HANA, and Fiori/UI5 integration.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in ABAP OO, CDS Views, AMDP, OData Services, RAP, and SAP integration technologies. The candidate should also possess functional understanding of at least one SAP domain, such as Finance (FI/CO), Order \& Billing Management (SD/BRIM), or Credit Management (FSCM).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain custom SAP ABAP applications in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Design and implement solutions using ABAP OO, CDS Views, AMDP, and OData Services.
* Develop and enhance SAP Fiori/UI5 applications.
* Work with ABAP on HANA and REST\-based services.
* Implement BAPIs, BADIs, Enhancements, and User Exits.
* Develop RICEF objects, including:
* Reports
* Interfaces
* Conversions
* Enhancements
* Forms
* Workflows
* Integrate SAP systems using IDocs, RFCs, APIs, and middleware technologies.
* Perform debugging, performance optimization, and code remediation.
* Support SAP S/4HANA migration and development activities.
* Translate functional requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Perform unit testing, integration testing, and defect resolution.
* Provide production support and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with functional consultants and cross\-functional teams.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Strong hands\-on experience in SAP ABAP development.
* Experience working in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Expertise in ABAP Object\-Oriented Programming (ABAP OO).
* Strong knowledge of:
* CDS Views
* AMDP
* OData Services
* BAPIs
* BADIs
* Enhancements
* User Exits
* Experience with ABAP on HANA and RAP.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP Fiori and UI5 integration.
* Experience in RICEF development.
* Strong understanding of SAP integration using IDocs, RFCs, APIs, and middleware.
* Experience in debugging, performance tuning, and S/4HANA migration.
* Ability to understand functional requirements and develop technical solutions.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.

**Functional Domain Knowledge**

Candidates must have functional understanding of at least one of the following domains:

* **Finance:** SAP FI/CO.
* **Order \& Billing Management:** SAP SD/BRIM.
* **Credit Management:** SAP FSCM.

**Preferred Skills**

* SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
* ABAP Cloud.
* Clean Core principles.
* Experience with global SAP implementations and rollouts.
* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA development and migration projects.

**Testing \& Support**

* Hands\-on experience in unit testing and integration testing.
* Defect identification and resolution.
* Production support and troubleshooting.
* Technical documentation and cross\-functional collaboration.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates with relevant SAP ABAP, Fiori, and S/4HANA development experience are encouraged to apply.

**Apply Here:**  
https://forms.gle/YUzQjXQQ8YCu2kid9

Pay: ₹2,500,000\.00 \- ₹3,430,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: SAP Subscription Management - SOM (BRIM) Solution Architect
jobs.description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
   

  

****Who We Are:****
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

****Job Description:****
 L2C Program
   

  

****Job Description****
**Role**
 Subscription/SW: SAP Subscription Management \- SOM (BRIM) Solution Architect
   

  

**Onshore / Offshore**
 Onshore
   

  

****Who We Are****
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves together and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career, our culture will embrace you.
   

  

****Job Description****
 HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build
 **HPE Networking** 
 , with the ambition of creating the
 **best networking business on the planet** 
 . This role sits at the center of that effort as part of
 **the Lead\-to\-Cash (L2C) program** 
 , responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a
 **single platform** 
 , replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.
   

  

 As part of a fast\-moving,
 **multi\-year transformation** 
 , the team will stabilize near\-term operations,
 **migrate core** 
**platforms, onboard businesses and suppliers globally** 
 , and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with
 **business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders** 
 on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.
   

  

 For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help
 **build a new business unit from its earliest days** 
 , rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain
 **hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale platform integration and cross\-functional program leadership** 
 , with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.
   

  

**Workstream\-Specific Details**
****Responsibilities****
* Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture for SAP Subscription Order Management (SOM) within SAP BRIM, covering subscription order capture, provisioning, and lifecycle change processes across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios.
* Define the target\-state design for subscription and consumption\-based offers, including product and rate\-plan modelling, technical and master agreements, and one\-off, recurring, and usage\-based charging.
* Architect integrations across the Lead\-to\-Cash landscape — CPQ and quoting, SAP SOM, Convergent Charging and Convergent Invoicing, FI\-CA, revenue accounting, and downstream fulfillment and entitlement systems.
* Translate business requirements into architecture artifacts: solution blueprints, process and data flows, interface specifications, and design decision records.
* Act as design authority for the workstream — review functional and technical designs, enforce SAP best practice, and resolve cross\-workstream design conflicts.
* Partner with the data and migration teams on the migration of legacy subscription contracts and install base into the unified platform.
* Guide onshore and offshore development teams through build, unit test, and defect resolution, ensuring delivery matches the approved design.
* Identify and mitigate design risks relating to scalability, performance, and operational supportability at HPE volumes.
* Support test strategy, cutover planning, and HyperCare, including root\-cause analysis of production issues in the subscription order flow.
* Advise business and IT leadership on trade\-offs, standard\-versus\-custom decisions, and roadmap alignment with SAP product direction.


****Education And Experience Required****
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; Master's degree an asset.
* 10\+ years of SAP experience, including 5\+ years focused on SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management).
* At least two full\-lifecycle SAP SOM implementations in a solution architect or lead design role, from blueprint through HyperCare.
* Demonstrated experience architecting subscription or consumption\-based commercial models in a high\-tech, networking, software, or telecommunications environment.
* Experience delivering within large, multi\-year transformation or post\-merger integration programs with global scope.
* Experience working in agile or SAFe delivery models with distributed onshor

jobs.title: SAP Developer - IT Customer & Metering Systems
jobs.description:
FirstEnergy at a Glance


We are a forward\-thinking electric utility powered by a diverse team of employees committed to making customers’ lives brighter, the environment better and our communities stronger.


FirstEnergy (NYSE: FE) is dedicated to safety, reliability, and operational excellence. Headquartered in Akron, Ohio, FirstEnergy includes one of the nation's largest investor\-owned electric systems, more than 24,500 miles of transmission lines that connect the Midwest and Mid\-Atlantic regions, and a regulated generating fleet with a total capacity of 3,780 megawatts.


This position is within FirstEnergy Service Co., a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp.


**Position Summary**
====================

FirstEnergy is seeking an SAP Developer to support its current SAP ECC environment and contribute to its ERP modernization efforts, with SAP S/4HANA as the preferred future\-state platform. This role focuses on developing, enhancing, integrating, and supporting SAP solutions for customer invoicing, payments, and collections.


This opportunity is well suited for candidates with a solid programming foundation who want to grow in SAP development. Recent college graduates with relevant coursework or internship experience, developers new to SAP, and those with hands\-on SAP experience are all encouraged to apply. The successful candidate will bring strong technical aptitude, a passion for problem solving, and a desire to continue learning.


**Primary Responsibilities**
============================

* Develop, maintain, and enhance SAP solutions supporting customer invoicing, payments, collections, and assistance programs.
* Partner with business clients and functional teams to analyze business requirements and translate them into effective technical specifications and solutions.
* Design, develop, and support SAP programs, reports, interfaces, workflows, enhancements, and integrations.
* Ensure solutions adhere to established development standards, security requirements, and best practices.
* Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve application defects and production issues.
* Develop and execute unit test plans and support user acceptance testing activities.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation for implemented solutions and support procedures.
* Provide day\-to\-day production support, including incident resolution, root cause analysis, and operational monitoring.
* Support nightly batch processing for customer billing, including occasional after\-hours support as needed.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience.
* Knowledge of programming concepts, software development principles, and application design and support practices.
* Understanding of software development lifecycle methodologies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, organizational, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Work independently while contributing effectively to team goals and objectives.
* Willingness to learn new technologies, business processes, platforms, and development tools.
* Strong commitment to customer service and process improvement.
* Fully proficient in Microsoft Office 365 suite.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Hands\-on experience developing or supporting SAP applications, including ABAP programming for reports, interfaces, and enhancements.
* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA and SAP Fiori through project work, training, or certification.
* Experience contributing to an ERP upgrade, migration, or implementation, such as custom code remediation, testing, or cutover support.
SAP IS\-U (Utilities) experience, particularly in billing, invoicing, or contract accounts receivable and payable (FI\-CA).  
* 

**Benefits, Compensation \& Workforce Diversity**

At FirstEnergy, employees are key to our success. We depend on their talents to meet the challenges of our changing business environment. We are committed to rewarding individual and team efforts through our total rewards philosophy which includes competitive pay plus incentive compensation, a company\-sponsored pension plan, 401(k) savings plan with matching employer contribution, a choice of medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, and life insurance programs, as well as skills development training with tuition reimbursement. Please visit our website at www.firstenergycorp.com to learn more about all of our employee rewards programs. FirstEnergy proudly supports workforce diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with a disability. No recruiters or agencies without a previously signed contract. Unable to sponsor or transfer H\-1B visas at this time.


**Safety**

Safety is a core value for FirstEnergy and is essential to all of our business activities. We ensure employees have the tools, information, and processes to perform their duties in a manner that assures safety for themselves, their co\-workers, our customers and the public. Our goals are to provide a safe work environment, to maintain an accident\-free, injury\-free workplace, and to promote and maintain public safety. To meet these goals, we dedicate ourselves to achieving world\-class safety standards.


**Position Classification**

Exempt


**FirstEnergy Human Resources Team**

jobs.description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.
   

  

**Primary Job Purpose**
 Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the Sales and Distribution (SD) module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Quote\-to\-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post\-go\-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.
   

  

**Key Position Accountabilities**
* Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP SD (Sales and Distribution) module configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested \& deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
* Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects \& leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance \& product management workstreams.
* Analyse business requirements related to sales quotations, sales orders management, order fulfilment, invoicing, returns and credit management processes. Internal
* Configure core SD components such as sales order types, item categories, ATP, pricing procedures, delivery types, billing types and work with technical teams for WRICEF developments
* Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
* Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go\-live and hyper care activities.
* Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.
* Collaborate with BRIM, MM, FI, PP and EWM module consultants to support cross\-functional processes.


**SELECTION CRITERIA**
**Essential** 
 :
   

  

* Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 7 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
* Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs \& support experience in Sales \& Distribution module in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects.
* Extensive experience in the core SD customizing including Quotations, Sales contracts, Sales order management, Available to Promise (ATP), outbound logistics, pricing, billing and returns and credit management.
* Hands\-on experience in SD configurations.
* Understanding on SAP Best Practices in SD module and their integrations \& technology.
* Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
* Strong communication skills in English, self\-driven and motivated.
* Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


**Desirable** 
 :
   

  

* SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP SD.
* Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
* Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.


**WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS**
* Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
* Health and Safety accountability statements.
* Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis. Internal

With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

jobs.title: SAP IS-U ORT Lead
jobs.description:
**Role Description**

We are seeking a senior Operational Readiness Testing (ORT) Lead to support a major utility's SAP IS\-U billing and payments go\-live. This is a strategy\-level, PMO\-facing role. You will define and own the ORT approach — not simply execute a pre\-built test plan — and ensure business processes, systems and operational teams are fully ready for go\-live through testing, defect resolution and performance validation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the end\-to\-end ORT strategy, applying risk\-based testing principles to prioritize scope, scenarios and coverage
* Set clear ORT scope, objectives and exit criteria, and explain how ORT differs from SIT, UAT and regression testing to stakeholders and business sponsors
* Identify and manage ORT\-specific risks such as data readiness, environment stability, cutover dependencies and business sign\-off, and build mitigations into the strategy
* Coordinate and execute bill compare activities, validating calculated bills against expected results across rates, billing determinants and customer scenarios
* Manage mass runs for billing, invoicing and payment processing to confirm system stability, performance and production readiness
* Develop ORT scripts, scenarios and acceptance criteria aligned with business and regulatory requirements
* Partner with functional, technical and business teams to identify defects, track resolution and validate fixes through retesting
* Ensure readiness of downstream processes including bill print, payment posting, collections and customer communications
* Provide daily ORT status reporting, risk identification and mitigation recommendations to project leadership
* Work with business SMEs to validate operational procedures, job aids and training materials for cutover and post\-go\-live support
* Support mock cutover activities and validate end\-to\-end operational workflows

**Required Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of IT/SAP experience, including 5\+ years in SAP IS\-U (preferred)
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP IS\-U Billing, Invoicing and Payments (FI\-CA)
* Demonstrated leadership of ORT, UAT or large\-scale testing cycles for utility implementations
* Proven ability to independently plan and lead a risk\-based ORT strategy for complex, multi\-workstream programs
* Deep understanding of billing determinants, rate structures and payment processing
* Experience executing or overseeing mass billing runs and bill comparison tools

jobs.title: SAP BRIM Developer
jobs.description:
**Experience:** 9\+ Years (Relevant Experience)  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Seniority Level:** Mid\-Senior to Senior Level

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **SAP BRIM Developer** with strong expertise in SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM) to design, develop, enhance, and support enterprise\-level billing and revenue management solutions.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience across **SAP SOM, Convergent Charging (CC), Convergent Invoicing (CI), and FI\-CA**, along with strong ABAP development and SAP S/4HANA integration capabilities.

Candidates should have experience working on subscription\-based and usage\-based billing models, enterprise integrations, performance optimization, and production support.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, enhance, and support SAP BRIM technical solutions across SOM, CC, CI, and FI\-CA.
* Develop custom ABAP programs, BADIs, user exits, enhancements, APIs, OData services, and workflows.
* Support subscription lifecycle management, including order capture, contract modifications, fulfillment, and provisioning.
* Develop and support charging, rating, pricing, and usage\-based billing solutions.
* Handle invoicing, billing aggregation, invoice generation, reconciliation, and financial posting processes.
* Support FI\-CA functionalities, including customer account management, payment processing, collections, dunning, and dispute management.
* Develop and maintain integrations between SAP BRIM, SAP S/4HANA, CRM/CX platforms, middleware, and third\-party systems.
* Perform unit testing, integration testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and defect resolution.
* Optimize application performance and ensure scalability for high\-volume billing and charging environments.
* Provide production support and participate in deployments, cutovers, and maintenance activities.
* Prepare technical specifications, interface documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Collaborate with SAP architects, functional consultants, integration teams, and business stakeholders.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* 7\+ years of SAP technical development experience.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on SAP BRIM development experience.
* Strong experience in SAP BRIM components:
* Subscription Order Management (SOM)
* Convergent Charging (CC)
* Convergent Invoicing (CI)
* Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI\-CA)
* Strong ABAP development expertise.
* Hands\-on experience with BADIs, User Exits, Enhancements, RFCs, APIs, and OData services.
* Good understanding of subscription\-based and usage\-based billing models.
* Experience with SAP HANA and SAP S/4HANA integrations.
* Knowledge of middleware, API integrations, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience in performance tuning, debugging, and production support.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills.

Preferred Certifications

* SAP Certified Development Associate – ABAP.
* SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP BRIM.
* SAP HANA Certification.
* SAP S/4HANA Technical Certification.
* SAP BTP or Cloud Certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.

Equivalent relevant professional experience may also be considered.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in mid\-to\-senior\-level professionals with **9\+ years of relevant experience**, strong hands\-on SAP BRIM development capabilities, and the ability to deliver scalable enterprise billing and revenue management solutions.

**If you have strong expertise in SAP BRIM (SOM, CC, CI, FI\-CA) and ABAP development, we would love to hear from you!**

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹150,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote
